summary: Turn learner needs into aligned outcomes, course maps and assessment plans. Explore this five-day curriculum design training course.
lede: Curriculum design training gives education and learning professionals a practical way to turn learning needs into coherent outcomes, course structures and assessment plans. It is for curriculum developers, instructional designers, and academic or training leads revising syllabi or planning programmes. Participants practise needs analysis, write outcomes using Bloom’s Taxonomy, map outcomes to learning activities and assessments, and plan curriculum reviews.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who shape, deliver, assess or review formal learning programmes and need a clearer connection between intended outcomes and observable learner evidence.
prerequisites: Bring experience contributing to a course, syllabus or workplace training plan. No coding or specialist software is required; exercises focus on curriculum documents and design artefacts.
